<thought>All experimental data (mass 194.086 Da, isotopic pattern indicating one chlorine, 12 carbons, 6 distinct aromatic carbons, aliphatic signals consistent with a cyclohexyl group) are satisfied by the structure Cl‑phenyl‑cyclohexane, i.e., a chlorobenzene ring bearing a cyclohexyl substituent. The SMILES "Clc1ccc(cc1)C2CCCCC2" is valid and yields the formula C12H15Cl, matching the observed data.</thought>
<final_answer>Clc1ccc(cc1)C2CCCCC2</final_answer>
